sources.entry: Life Saver - An abstract screensaver based on Conway's Game of Life implemented with SpriteKit

summary.one_liner: Life Saver is an abstract, artistic Conway's Game of Life screensaver and Apple TV app built with SpriteKit.
summary.what_it_does: Implements Conway's Game of Life as an abstract visual piece using SpriteKit. The README says it offers a variety of settings and color schemes. It ships in two forms: a macOS screensaver, with a download link for v1.2, and an Apple TV app, available through the App Store. A YouTube video demonstrates the screensaver. The README also points to a forum for devlogs, discussion, and support. To build from source, clone the repo, open Life Saver.xcodeproj in Xcode, and pick a target to run.
use_cases: generative art visuals for a screen
notable: Conway's Game of Life rendered as an abstract artistic screensaver
Two targets: macOS screensaver and Apple TV app
Community forum for devlogs and support
caveats: Apple TV version is distributed through the App Store, and the macOS screensaver is a separate download
Source build requires Xcode; the README does not list other requirements
The README does not name a license
